newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Nat'l Nonferrous special company ups FRN.
newsitem.headline: China Nat'l Nonferrous special company ups FRN.

text.p: J-Trading and Investment's secured floating rate note issue has been increased to US$150 million from US$100 million due to oversubscription, arranger IBJ Asia said.
The deal is secured by an import contract with China National Nonferrous Metals Industry Corp.
J-Trading is a special purpose company wholly-owned by China National Nonferrous Metals Industry, a source close to the issue said.
The facility has a final maturity of two years. It pays a coupon of 130 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.

Arrangers and lead managers, with US$10 million each, are IBJ Asia, Industrial Bank of Korea, KDB Asia, KEXIM Asia, KLB Asia Finance, KorAm Bank, and Korea Commercial Finance. Arranger China Construction Bank committed US$5 million.
Co-lead managers with US$10 million each are ING Bank and Mitsui Trust Finance.

Senior managers, with US$5 million each, are Bank of East Asia, First Merchant Banking Corp, Hana Finance Asia, Hanwha Merchant Bank, Korean French Banking Corp, and Malayan Banking. Peregrine Fixed Income, committed US$4 million.
Managers, with US$3 million each, are DongNam Finance Hong Kong, KEB Leasing & Finance, KIMB Finance, Kwangju Bank, LG Finance Hong Kong, Overseas Union Bank and Pusan Bank.
